# CANDIDATE: CHART_STOP_BUFFER_INCREASE_TO_1_00

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Increasing the chart stop buffer from $0.50 to $1.00 will reduce premature stop-outs on bearish rejection setups, allowing winning trades to capture more of the downward move on days like 4/29 and 5/01, while not significantly increasing losses on loser days because the buffer remains relatively tight. The current baseline loses on two winner days (-23.95 and -21.56) due to early stop triggers; a wider buffer may let these trades run further into profit.

## Mechanism

The chart stop is triggered when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + buffer (params.json#chart_stop_buffer_dollars). Increasing this buffer from 0.50 to 1.00 means the price must close further above the rejected level to trigger the stop, giving the trade more room to withstand small retracements without being stopped out. Exit logic otherwise remains unchanged: chandelier profit-lock arms at +5% and trails 0.15 off HWM, premium stop is −50% catastrophe cap, time stop 15:50 ET.
